title: How Fair Oaks Townhomes Collect Route 50 and I-66 Dust
headline: Mall-area stacks, Fair Lakes closets, and why this is not the City of Fairfax page
description: Fair Oaks, VA sits at the I-66 / Route 50 interchange around the mall and Fair Lakes. Learn why townhome ducts load corridor dust, and when to clean them from Burke.

sections.heading: Fair Oaks is the mall grid — not Old Town Fairfax
paragraphs: Housing around Fair Oaks Mall, West Ox, and the I-66 / Route 50 interchange is mostly 1980s–2000s townhomes and HOA singles. Visitor lots sit in traffic film. Attic air handlers run hot in July, then dump that dust downstairs every time the system starts. Fair Lakes is next door. Fairfax Corner is adjacent — city addresses belong on the [Fairfax](/locations/fairfax) page; the mall / Fair Lakes grid belongs here.
A unit that looks “too new to clean” often still has builder drywall dust in the trunks. Corridor grit from 50 and 66 never stopped adding to it.

sections.heading: Townhome dryer chases clog before the paint looks old
paragraphs: Stacked laundry sends lint up a chase that turns too many times. The closet stays humid. Returns pull Beltway-adjacent dust and infill construction along Route 50. Together they are why registers gray out a week after you wipe them.
If the laundry stays hot and the supplies look dirty, start with [air duct cleaning in Fair Oaks, VA](/locations/fair-oaks).

sections.heading: Typical signs in a Fair Oaks townhome
listItems: Gray film on supplies even in a 1990s–2000s unit.
Dust returning fast if you face 50, 66, or West Ox.
A dryer that needs two cycles and a humid laundry closet.

sections.heading: Burke dispatch — not a kiosk at the mall
paragraphs: Fair Oaks is served from our [Burke](/locations/burke) office. Nearby [Fairfax](/locations/fairfax) and [Chantilly](/locations/chantilly) use the same crew. There is no Fair Oaks storefront.
Book on the [Fair Oaks location page](/locations/fair-oaks). Add [dryer vent cleaning](/dryer-vent-cleaning) for stacked laundry.
listItems: Ask for a duct cleaning if the trunks were never cleaned after the builder left.
Change filters more often on 50/66 air.
Clear townhome dryer vents about once a year.

faq.q: Is Fair Oaks the same as the City of Fairfax?
faq.a: No. Fair Oaks is the county community around the mall, Fair Lakes, and the 50/66 interchange. The independent city has its own page. Both dispatch from Burke.

faq.q: Why do Fair Oaks townhomes get dusty so fast?
faq.a: Corridor traffic, attic handlers, and leftover builder dust. Returns pull the mix. Filters do not empty the trunks.

faq.q: Who cleans air ducts in Fair Oaks, VA?
faq.a: Amazon Air Duct Cleaning serves Fair Oaks from the Burke office. Book on the [Fair Oaks location page](/locations/fair-oaks) or call (571) 460-0001.
